name: skeleton-sweep
title: Skeleton Sweep
description: Loading placeholders with one band of light sweeping across the whole layout.

perf.budget: One repeating timing per group; each block applies a single translate. Pauses when `active` is false.

measurements.notes: Sweeps by design while loading; unmounts with the placeholder.

a11y.screenReader: The group is a busy progress bar with a label ('Loading' by default); individual blocks are hidden.
